additional_info.subject: Note
additional_info.body:
VIV:0 PLE:1 KON:1,
RNE:1,SOV:1
The following values show the
error state
(OK state would be the negated value):
VIV:0 → in case of an invalid sensor reading
CCE:1→ in case of missing cable configuration
RNE:1 → in case of an sensor reading outside the defined operation range
PLE:1→ in case of an plausibility error (temperature difference between +/- 25 deg C too high)
SOV:1 → in case of the defined overheat limit is exceeded
COV:1→ in case of the CAN bus read out temperature values has exceeded the defined overheat limit
CBL:1 → in case of CAN Bus communication lost
KON:1: → in case the contact temperature sensors are not okay
CBL:1 → in case the cable temperature sensors are not okay
HOU:1 → in case the housing temperature sensor is not okay
CFeed:1 → in case the coolant feed temperature sensor is not okay
CRet:1 → in case the coolant return temperature sensors are not okay

additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0420067 ﻿from the
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
to the
eMobility RC-DE SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s):
Reason
Applicable
Onsite Repair (Component Exchange)
X(May be)
Onsite Troubleshooting
X
End Customer Communication
X
Spare Part Ordering
X(May be)
Performance monitoring by RC
Note:
Need to check below points in Dispenser
1) Check CCS2 Plug for any dust or crack in DC4
2) Check PT1000 resistance values in terminal +F220-XD212:(5,6,7,8) & check connection and tightness in terminal of KF214
3) If Resistance value abnormal then CCS2 needs to be placed
MLFB: 8EM5903-0AA02-6AA2 :+F210-XD240 :qTY1
4) Check DC+ & DC- RESISTANCE
5) In logs it is observed multiple times
DC4_CableTempSensor_XD240 fault has appeared &
Charging Cable Sensor Plausibility Contact Temperatures: 12.6, 63.1 deg C observed.
Kindly pick up the case using "
Pick
" option in the queue or manually using the "
Assign
" function from the
eMobility RC-DE SI E Queue (Level 2)
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the Notes in the case timeline or under documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require expert support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
.
If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution and send survey email to the customer.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Sunil Sharma
